name: Documentation
description: Ability to create and maintain technical documentation including procedures, methodologies, work instructions, and knowledge base articles. Distinct from report writing (FOUND-REPORT) which focuses on engagement deliverables — this covers internal lab documentation that ensures repeatability and knowledge transfer.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to technical documentation practices

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the importance of documented procedures and knowledge management
evidence: Can find and follow existing lab procedures
Understands why procedures must be documented

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Contributes to documentation under guidance; follows documentation standards
evidence: Has updated or contributed to existing procedure documents
Follows the lab's documentation format and style

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Authors complete procedures and knowledge base articles independently
evidence: Authored 3+ procedure documents or work instructions
Documents are clear, complete, and usable by others

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Maintains documentation systems; reviews others' contributions; ensures consistency
evidence: Reviews and maintains a section of the lab's documentation
Ensures consistency across procedures and work instructions
Mentors junior staff on documentation practices

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Designs documentation framework; manages knowledge base architecture
evidence: Designed the lab's documentation structure and standards
Manages the overall knowledge base architecture
Trains teams on documentation practices and standards

assessment_methods.description: Review 3 procedure documents or knowledge base articles authored by the individual
